tool_args.rationale: The positive short-window responses do not establish the sign at H = 22.2. The slow-horizon probe targets the ambiguity that matters for confirmation: whether delayed adaptation overcomes the initial gain.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations are at H ≤ 0.48. They cannot separately constrain the slow adaptation amplitude and time constant well enough to forecast at H = 22.2.
Denser trajectory sampling may refine the fast response, but the slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the positive pilot response persists or reverses.

considered_alternatives.option: Uncoupled dual-horizon model or static Haldane inhibition
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both omit the observed sink-gradient signature, and the static model cannot represent a horizon-dependent reversal.
